heading: Definition
lead: For purposes of this chapter, “State” includes the District of Columbia and the territories and possessions of the United States.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 15150136:2013.Aug. 9, 1982, Pub. L. 97–231, § 14, 96 Stat. 258. The words “the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico” are omitted as included in “the territories and possessions of the United States”.
